settings_panel.title: Game Settings
settings_panel.custom_layouts_desc: Define CSS grid templates for specific player counts (e.g. '1fr 1fr' or '1fr \n 1fr').
settings_panel.default_view_desc: Choose whether the song library defaults to a list or grid view.
settings_panel.autoplay_no_singers_desc: Time before autoplaying the next song if no one is singing.
settings_panel.autoplay_singers_desc: Time before autoplaying the next song when singers are active.
settings_panel.default_click_desc: Action when clicking a song in the library.
settings_panel.max_items_desc: Maximum number of cards to display per row.
settings_panel.mode_separated_desc: Plays separated instrumental and vocal stems when available. Allows independent vocal volume control.
settings_panel.mode_original_desc: Plays the untouched original audio track directly.
settings_panel.lyrics_scale_desc: Adjust the size of the lyrics on the main screen.
settings_panel.lyrics_zoom_desc: Zoom and glow active lyric syllables during singing. Disable for simple color highlighting.
settings_panel.lyrics_lines_desc: Choose how many lines of lyrics to display.
settings_panel.lyrics_min_size_desc: Lyrics shrink down to this size, then wrap. At 100% they never shrink.
settings_panel.lyrics_rows_desc: Lyrics are sized to fit automatically. With 2 rows, long lines wrap and the text stays larger. Very long lines wrap either way.
settings_panel.lyrics_position_desc: Choose whether lyrics appear at the bottom or in the center when no singers are active.
settings_panel.vocals_offset_desc: Adjust timing between backing track and vocal stem in milliseconds. Positive = vocals earlier, Negative = vocals later.
settings_panel.mic_latency_desc: Compensates for microphone and audio hardware delay to align pitch detection with note bars.
settings_panel.fallback_background_desc: Shown when a song has no video. Use a web link or select a local file (local files may reset after reload).
settings_panel.show_scoreboard_qr: Show QR Code in Score & Wait Screens
settings_panel.show_scoreboard_qr_desc: Displays a QR code on score overviews and waiting screens so players can easily join or connect.
settings_panel.reset_confirm: Reset all game settings to factory defaults? Profiles will not be affected.
settings_panel.calibrate_blocked: Cannot calibrate while a song is playing.
